name: slopsquat-guard
description: Stops Claude from installing hallucinated or typosquatted packages: every npm, pip, uv, poetry, cargo and gem install is checked against its registry first. Packages that don't exist are blocked; brand-new, barely used or lookalike packages ask you first.

minAgeDays.title: Minimum age (days)
minAgeDays.description: A package first published fewer days ago than this asks you first.

minWeeklyDownloads.title: Minimum weekly downloads
minWeeklyDownloads.description: A package with fewer weekly downloads than this asks you first (npm, PyPI, crates.io; RubyGems is estimated from lifetime downloads).

allowList.title: Always allowed
allowList.description: Comma-separated package names never checked, such as your private or internal packages.

timeoutMs.title: Registry timeout (ms)
timeoutMs.description: How long to wait for a registry before letting the install run unchecked.
